card: Adds test vectors to script_tests.json covering signature and public key canonical encoding edge cases in the script interpreter. Mutation testing on bitcoincore.space identified six live mutants surviving in interpreter.cpp, including boundary checks for DERSIG signature length limits, signature total-length byte verification, single-byte null R and S values, and STRICTENC pubkey prefix checks. Four of the covered checks exercise DERSIG consensus rules, one exercises STRICTENC policy rules, and a 3-byte signature test checks the lower-bound guard preventing out-of-bounds reads. No dependencies.
changed_since_previous: Rebased or adjusted test vector formatting without changing the scope or set of covered mutant checks.
evidence: Identifies six specific surviving mutants from bitcoincore.space in `src/script/interpreter.cpp` covering lines 81, 130, 136, 162, 175, and 129 (PR description).
problem: Boundary conditions in signature and public key encoding verification were missing from `script_tests.json`, leaving several synthetic mutations in consensus and policy validation logic undetected by the test suite.
